## Description of Changes

<!-- Clearly and concisely describe what was implemented, improved, or fixed. -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat:` New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix:` Bug fix
- [ ] `docs:` Documentation update
- [ ] `build:` Build dependencies, tooling, or automation
- [ ] `refactor:` Code refactoring without behavioral alterations
- [ ] `test:` Adding or adjusting automated tests
- [ ] `perf:` Performance enhancement

## Quality & Security Checklist
- [ ] The command `make check` passed with exit code 0.
- [ ] Automated test coverage verified (floor >= 90%, preferably 100%).
- [ ] Zero credentials, secrets, or machine-specific paths committed (`make scan`, `make portability`).
- [ ] Commit messages strictly follow the Conventional Commits specification in English.
- [ ] User-facing UI elements, notifications, and labels are localized in formal, technical Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
- [ ] UI copy avoids stating the obvious and prevents leaking internal business rules or technical errors.
